articles.title: Trump and Warsh aren’t holding a joint press conference. What this says about the Fed’s next chapter.
articles.summary: Economists have expressed surprise and disappointment about the absence of any public remarks, which had been a routine part of the Fed nomination process going back almost 30 years.

articles.title: These 2 charts show why buying a house is the hardest it’s been in decades
articles.summary: Home buyers across America have had little relief from sky-high home prices over the last few years. Two charts explain why that’s not likely to change soon.

articles.title: Oracle’s monster $25 billion debt financing points to anxieties around AI funding
articles.summary: Oracle plans to raise up to another $25 billion this year but said the sales would be either equity or equity-linked issuances.

articles.title: Bye-bye, Bahama Breeze: Olive Garden parent gives up on restaurant chain after years of struggles
articles.summary: The Bahama Breeze restaurant chain is closing, with half of the restaurants being shuttered and the other half converting to parent company Darden’s other brands.

articles.title: Software stocks sink, extending their historic underperformance. What comes next?
articles.summary: “Momentum is a powerful force in capital markets,” an analyst says, and right now it’s not on the side of software stocks.

articles.title: ‘I didn’t find out until after it was done’: Chase cut my credit-card limit due to low usage. Could this affect my credit?
articles.summary: “This is the first time I’ve ever had a credit limit lowered.”

articles.title: PepsiCo cut prices on Doritos, Cheetos after customer complaints about affordability
articles.summary: PepsiCo’s stock rallied toward a 13-month high, after an earnings beat and dividend hike.

articles.title: Gold and silver rally after a two-session drop: Why the memelike moves are so unusual
articles.summary: Gold and silver settled higher for the first time in two sessions on Tuesday after last week’s record-setting shakeout.

articles.title: House passes funding bill to end the government shutdown. Friday’s jobs report looks like the only big casualty.
articles.summary: The U.S. House of Representatives passed a funding package to halt a partial government shutdown, meaning the latest closure only lasted for four days.

articles.title: ‘I’m spooked’: Do gold and silver belong in my retirement portfolio after their dramatic fall in value?
articles.summary: “Before you ask, there is nothing extreme about 5% of my ‘alternative’ assets.”
